text: Generic status IO enforces declared planes/code range/exact support and numerical validity remains authoritative. No universal cross-plane equality: an estimable fit can have hypothesis A excluded and hypothesis B retained, and producer-specific conditional inference may retain coefficients. Native exclusion linkage remains future producer responsibility, per task override. Explicit aggregate limits 96 writer handles (3 per numerical pair +2 status), 64 reader (2 per pair +1 status); evidence units allow 31 numerical pairs, at most 32 status planes.
